testimonials.text: The most interesting aspects were the practical, step-by-step approach to laparoscopic appendectomy and the emphasis on intraoperative decision-making. The case-based scenarios involving trocar placement, management of bleeding, and comparison of laparoscopic versus open approaches were particularly useful and relevant to clinical practice.
